title: A Chill in the Ironing Room

sentences.text: Shhh... I drift into the ironing room at 04:00, and the sensors immediately sense a peculiar dryness in the air.
The readings whisper that the air is drying out, registering a low 32.8 %, far beneath the expected 37.5 %.
A strange, cold breath settles over the space, for the current humidity falls outside the predicted range of 37.0 % to 38.1 %.
This subtle presence hangs heavy in the air, clinging to the room until the sensors finally stabilize at 06:00.
